# obix-config-typescript

> Previous name: `@obinexusltd/obix-config-typescript` — OBIX packages are named without an npm scope since decision D-102 (2026-09-29); the package, its version and its exports are unchanged.

OBIX TypeScript configuration for OBIX CLI and SDK packages

Part of the OBIX monorepo (config/obix-config-typescript). See docs/recovery/ at the repository root for provenance and status.

<!-- obix-release:begin — generated by scripts/release/prepare.mjs; edit the text above this line -->

## Installation

```bash
npm install obix-config-typescript
```

> **Not yet on npm.** The OBIX packages are prepared for publication and are published only on the owner's authorisation; until then this is the command the published package will answer to.

## Basic usage

```js
import { baseConfig, developmentConfig, productionConfig, resolveConfig } from 'obix-config-typescript';
```

## API surface

- `obix-config-typescript` — 4 value exports: `baseConfig`, `developmentConfig`, `productionConfig`, `resolveConfig`
- `obix-config-typescript/base` — asset `./base/tsconfig.json`
- `obix-config-typescript/development` — asset `./development/tsconfig.json`
- `obix-config-typescript/production` — asset `./production/tsconfig.json`
- `obix-config-typescript/nodenext` — asset `./nodenext/tsconfig.json`
- Type declarations: `./dist/index.d.ts` (and a declaration next to every JS entry point).

## Architecture role

`obix-config-typescript` is a **tool preset**: shared configuration for the tooling of an OBIX project (development-time only).

The architecture of OBIX — the package families and which packages are public API — is indexed in the umbrella: [docs/architecture.md](https://github.com/obinexus/obix/blob/main/docs/architecture.md).

## Package relationships

- Depends on (OBIX): no other OBIX package.
- Used by (OBIX): no other OBIX package.

## Testing

- 2 test files ship in the npm package (`test/`): they are the evidence of the package's contract, published so that its verification can be read — not runtime code (no entry point reaches them).
- Run them with `npm test` (`node --test "test/*.test.mjs"`) in the OBIX monorepo, which provides the test tooling (Node's test runner, TypeScript).
